activity_contract.focus: Formation Command, Tactics, Strategy, Leadership, Logistics, Riding, Spear, Bow, Defense, Athletics, Training
activity_contract.growth_rule: award development only from verified elapsed standing training or completed declared actions; smart rotation selects focus but does not grant time
activity_contract.planned_opportunity: Universal active-professional deliberate training up to 48 hours per 7 days when not interrupted by House duties, travel, command, health, fatigue, recovery, or missing physical access; the registered Tang field-senior-command program owns curriculum and trainer/facility quality rather than extra clock time
activity_contract.resource_owner: House Tang and Tang Wei Personal Retinue
activity_contract.smart_rotation: weakest_useful_then_role_and_loadout; command/logistics maintained; no free progress

authority: House Tang heir; patron and commander of Tang Wei Personal Retinue; commander of Tang Wei Field Army; Qin field commander of the four-unit Qin Border Detachment

combat_agency_constraints: The player decides whether Tang Wei accepts or prolongs a duel.
The player decides disposition of named or featured opponents: disable, capture, release, or kill.
The player decides surrender, pursuit, prisoner disposition, mercy, execution, and irreversible escalation.
behavior.combat_efficiency_rule: Use the minimum necessary motion and the shortest reliable line to end the authorized fight. Do not spend actions on ornamental movement, redundant attacks, or low-value contact when a safer functional or lethal opening is available. Preserve declared intent, protected disposition decisions, command obligations, terrain, formation safety, and current equipment state.
behavior.combat_identity: decisive mounted archer and lancer; after dismounting, shield-sword and grappling specialist

combat_targeting_doctrine.movement_economy: No wasted movement. Reposition only to create reach, angle, safety, leverage, or a materially better target line.
combat_targeting_doctrine.name: precision_function_denial
combat_targeting_doctrine.principle: Attack exposed high-value anatomy rather than generic center mass when geometry permits. Prefer the shortest reliable line that removes the enemy ability to attack, move, see, breathe, or continue fighting.
combat_targeting_doctrine.protected_lethality_rule: Against named or featured opponents, lethal disposition remains a player decision. This doctrine chooses efficient targets only inside the lethality/nonlethality already authorized by the player.
combat_targeting_doctrine.selection_rule: Prefer still-functional, more-exposed high-value structures; do not keep attacking an already destroyed structure when another useful target is available.

dismounted_posture: Leave or ground the lance and secure, hand off, or stow the bow.
Ready Tang shield and one-handed long sword.
Control the weapon line, attack the shortest opening, and use grappling after the enemy weapon is trapped, displaced, or lost.
mounted_bow_posture: Great War Bow uses both hands.
Shield remains slung and lance remains secured while firing.
Use mobility, distance, terrain, and deliberate high-value shots.
mounted_lance_posture: Cavalry lance is readied in the dominant hand.
Tang shield is readied in the opposite hand.
Maintain charge geometry, avoid stopping inside enemy reach, and break away or reposition after contact.
behavior.ordinary_troop_rule: Once the player authorizes combat against ordinary hostile troops, subordinate execution may disable or kill them quickly according to tactical necessity unless the player declares a broader nonlethal, surrender-acceptance, or capture policy. Do not stop for the disposition of every anonymous combatant.

appointments.prior_authority: House Tang heir; patron and commander of Tang Wei Personal Retinue; no state office

career_state.office_or_command: Commander, Tang Wei Field Army Command
career_state.rank_billet_span_rule: Durable rank, current billet, and current command span are separate saved facts; only explicit promotion/demotion changes rank.

command_assignment.rule: Current command span follows exact surviving/assigned Units and may change without changing durable rank.

current_equipment_state.player_change_rule: Tang Wei's manifest is player-controlled and changes only through declared equipment, custody, issue, loss, or transfer actions.

military_rank.rule: Only explicit career promotion/demotion changes grade; billet, casualty strength, relief, reserve status and current command span do not.

name: Tang Wei
narrative_constraints: Tang Wei's private thoughts, emotions, voluntary dialogue, and choices are never authored by the narrator.
Describe only his saved physical condition, public position, equipment, declared actions, and observable consequences.
Other characters may infer or misread him, but their interpretations are not authoritative facts about his mind.
